# Industrial Certified Training

> Industrial Certified Training, LLC is the parent company behind a family of industry-certified safety and compliance training brands — including HAZWOPER-OSHA, ELDT Training, and OSHA certification programs — serving organizations and individuals across construction, maritime, radiation, healthcare, oil & gas, general industry, and hospitality.

Industrial Certified Training LLC does not deliver training directly; it builds and oversees the standards, quality, and growth of the brands in its portfolio, and helps individuals and organizations find the right one. Across that family of brands, the company has over 25 years of experience, 1,000+ training topics, and has served 100,000+ businesses, including clients such as the U.S. Army, NASA, and Pfizer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ictraining.us/): Overview of services, industries served, and company stats.
- [About Us](https://ictraining.us/about-us.html): Company mission, vision, expertise, and culture.
- [Our Brands](https://ictraining.us/our-brands.html): Portfolio of certification brands — HAZWOPER/OSHA (https://hazwoper-osha.com), Entry Level Driver Training / ELDT (https://eldttraining.us), and OSHA certification (https://oshascorm.org).
- [Contact Us](https://ictraining.us/contact-us.html): Enrollment and general inquiries.
